head: d5831d7613e8c8edd2adf76fbd7b86b408e62de6
verified: Exact original hash and supplied patch hash match assignment; patch applies uniquely in memory; current fixture differs from patched text only in reviewed whitespace formatting.
Ingress call/return tracing selects only h1-tiny_window_1mib owner PID via self match-spec guard, and only public Exchange.read_body_step/3 and ThousandIsland.Socket.recv/3.
Reads public exchange phase whitelist, credit/wait/size scalars and returned body byte_size; never stores or serializes Exchange, socket, Session, body contents or full arguments/results.
Finite phase/category/operation/one-byte-versus-bulk keys bound count/duration metric cardinality; retains first8/last8 plus scalar byte totals and count,total,min,max aggregates.
At most one scalar event context per read operation and one reply timestamp for the selected owner; per-PID contexts deleted on DOWN.
Trace patterns cleared on completion, owner DOWN and observer stop; all owner receive/call/timestamp flags disabled at stop. Timestamped existing public error/event tracking preserved.
Assertion256 and original opening/normal/timeout/cleanup deadlines unchanged.
limits: recv phase labels the enclosing read step entry, not private decoder state at each socket call.
A trace context is diagnostic only and not a complete execution history; tracing may affect scheduling.
No runtime or UP2 acceptance inferred; no tests, Mix, format, product imports or source mutations by reviewer.
Parent-owned peer stderr diagnostic is outside this fixture review.
